narrativeProgression.description: Havoc recalls meeting a woman while on tour and getting her number.
Prodigy suggests that they all meet up with the woman.
Havoc, Prodigy, and others drive to meet the woman.
The woman suggests having a party, and a large group gathers at Havoc’s friend’s place.
The party gets out of hand, with people drinking, dancing, and engaging in sexual activity.
One of Havoc’s friends breaks his ankle during the party.
Havoc leaves the party disgusted and never speaks to the woman again.
